page.overview:
What is World Government?

The World Government is a federation of over 170 nations that governs most of the world. Founded by an alliance of 20 kingdoms eight centuries ago, it has vastly grown in influence since. Its capital is the land of Mary Geoise atop the Red Line intersecting the Grand Line, although the government maintains official facilities and bases across the world.

In the public's view, the World Government is an oligarchy ruled over by the aristocratic descendants of its founders known as the World Nobles, chief among them the Five Elders, alongside a limited representative council of local rulers known as the Levely. Despite claims to be decentralized with no single ruler, founder Nerona Imu secretly holds total authority over the government as King of the World. The government oversees the Marines, Cipher Pol, and Pacifista, which serve as peacekeeping and military forces; it previously oversaw the Seven Warlords of the Sea before their dissolution.

The standards and objectives of the World Government naturally put it at odds with lawless pirates, and it has historically oppressed numerous islands and groups; thus, it serves as overarching antagonists of the One Piece series. The Straw Hat Pirates have come into conflict with affiliates of the World Government throughout the series, and directly declared war on the institution during the Enies Lobby Arc.

The main symbol of the World Government is a blue cross consisting of five circles of equal size, with four circles surrounding the fifth one at 90 degree angles to each other; the four outside circles are connected to the fifth interior circle by thin lines of equal length. The cross is accompanied by the words "World Govt."
